name: Macao International Airport

handling.v: TAG Aviation (Macau) runs a 24-hour business-aviation FBO, the airport's second FBO (opened January 2019)
handling.quote: the second commercial/general aviation fixed base operator (FBO) of Macau International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 16/34, 45 m wide plus two 7.5 m shoulders; length 3,360 m (runway 34) and 3,285 m (runway 16)

max_aircraft.v: all types up to the Boeing 747-400; 25 apron stands, 15 of them business jet stands
max_aircraft.quote: Type of Aircraft Serviced All types up to B747-400 ... Apron Stands 25 ... Business Jet Stands 15

permits.v: non-scheduled flights need a flight authorisation from the Civil Aviation Authority (AACM), applied for by the operator or agent through the Flight Application System; processing takes 3 working days after all documents are in
permits.quote: It takes 3 working days to complete the authorization process

notes: AIP Macao (AACM) is not available online; only the Hong Kong eAIP page (procedures in HK airspace) could be read.
